drivingQuestion: From where do we know the bird sin offering's meat is eaten by priests?
outcomeNote: answered by Levi's baraita, whose clauses follow in the next units

segments.he: חַטַּאת הָעוֹף – דָּמָהּ מַתִּיר אֶת בְּשָׂרָהּ לַכֹּהֲנִים. מְנָא הָנֵי מִילֵּי? דְּתָנֵי לֵוִי:
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: With regard to «the bird burnt offering, its blood renders its meat» and its skin «permitted to» be eaten by «the priests.» The Gemara asks: «From where is this matter,» that the meat of a bird burnt offering is eaten by the priests, derived? The Gemara cites a baraita «that Levi teaches,» with regard to a verse that discusses the gifts that are to be presented to the priests: “This shall be yours of the most sacred items, from the fire: Every offering of theirs, every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every guilt offering of theirs, which they shall render to Me, shall be most sacred for you and for your sons” (Numbers 18:9).
